name: Greedy Meshing UV Recomputation & Gradient Stabilization
aliases: Stable gradient sampling for greedy faces
definition: A shader injection technique that recomputes UV coordinates and texture derivatives for greedy-meshed faces to ensure correct texture tiling and stable mipmapping across block boundaries.
summary: Greedy Meshing UV Recomputation & Gradient Stabilization is a shader injection that recomputes UVs and derivatives for greedy faces to eliminate seams and stabilize mipmapping, distinctively using smooth gradients per face orientation instead of interpolated coordinates.
